title: Aira: choose a price-lookup theme
question: Compare the mockups before coding. All show the same sample product. Choose a direction, request changes, or ask for a fresh set.

options.label: Tindahan Window
options.lineage: The familiar service window of a neighborhood tindahan
options.thesis: A warm frame opens directly onto the answer you need.
options.viewport: A compact Aira header; one large lookup field; a framed product and price; speech and typing actions below.
options.risk: The frame must stay light enough to leave room for product details.

raised.raise: Give every variant and selling unit a stable, immediately scannable position.
Make the answer earn the screen: secondary decoration cannot compete with it.
Commit the warm framing to one continuous region, rather than sprinkling accents.
Keep product identity and its price aligned as one reading unit.
Build a deliberate price-to-caption scale contrast.

options.label: Friendly Price Board
options.lineage: Handwritten neighborhood price signs, translated into legible Android typography
options.thesis: A welcoming shop sign makes the product and price impossible to miss.
options.viewport: Short conversational prompt, large search field, a bold lavender price board, and a prominent speech button.
options.risk: The familiar search-and-answer structure is effective but less surprising.

options.label: Price Ticket
options.lineage: Segmented boarding passes and live status boards
options.thesis: A tidy lookup ticket keeps the product, unit, and price together.
options.viewport: Search and speech above a segmented answer ticket; a visible correction link; native navigation below.
options.case: Strong product clarity; less neighborhood warmth than the window.
options.risk: Ticket segmentation can feel administrative if captions become too dense.

options.label: Catalog Grid
options.thesis: An alias catalog grouped into tappable product cells.
options.viewport: A dense catalog gives each product a fixed location.
options.risk: Product cells would crowd the single-answer task and need imagery the catalog does not store.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and weaker task clarity than Tindahan Window.
options.kept: Stable positions for product identity, variant, and unit.

options.label: Quiet Product Proof
options.thesis: A mostly neutral lookup screen proves each answer with catalog details.
options.viewport: An austere answer block follows a small search field.
options.risk: Lower neighborhood identification and a less inviting capture affordance.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and weaker task clarity than Tindahan Window.
options.kept: Let the real answer dominate over decoration.

options.label: Garden Guide
options.thesis: Organic color regions divide lookup, answer, and correction.
options.viewport: The answer sits inside one swelling green region.
options.risk: Spatial regions add interpretation to a simple lookup and compete with native controls.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and weaker task clarity than Tindahan Window.
options.kept: One dominant color region instead of scattered decoration.

options.label: Reference Rail
options.thesis: A catalog label and price share a strict reading rail.
options.viewport: A narrow answer column pairs product facts around one aligned rail.
options.risk: Small annotations and printed state marks weaken familiar Android interaction.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and weaker task clarity than Tindahan Window.
options.kept: Align product identity and price as one reading unit.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: The price becomes the central specimen, supported by precise labels.
options.viewport: A giant numeric answer follows a compact capture area.
options.risk: A dominant numeral risks hiding variant and unit, and a slider has no honest lookup job.
options.case: Declined: weaker audience identification and weaker task clarity than Tindahan Window.
options.kept: Deliberate scale contrast without losing product identity.

canonCard.label: Familiar Android
canonCard.thesis: A familiar Material-style lookup screen with careful spacing and a single strong action.
canonCard.viewport: Standard top app bar, search field, answer card, speech action, and a three-destination navigation bar.
canonCard.risk: Easy to learn, but less distinct as Aira’s own theme.
